title: Base change of the readings of constant line families
statement: Fix a finite purity datum $P$ [def-pur-conventions], arbitrary schemes $B,B\prime$ and a morphism $b:B\prime\to B$. Write $a,a\prime$ for the affine-line projections and $v$ for the induced line map. Take arbitrary derived pro-etale objects $C,C\prime$ on the bases and $F,F\prime$ on their lines, with isomorphisms $\kappa:F\simeq a^*C$, $\kappa\prime:F\prime\simeq a\prime{}^*C\prime$, $T:v^*F\simeq F\prime$, and $c:b^*C\simeq C\prime$. Assume that any two isomorphisms $F\prime\simeq a\prime{}^*D$ agreeing at one are equal, for every $D$. Define $r_j=i_j^*\kappa\,\epsilon_j$ and $r_j\prime=i_j\prime{}^*\kappa\prime\,\epsilon_j\prime$, with the canonical pullback section constraints, and let $q_j:b^*i_j^*F\simeq i_j\prime{}^*v^*F$ be the canonical endpoint pullback comparison [def-pur-section-restriction-data]. If $q_1(i_1\prime{}^*T)r_1\prime=(b^*r_1)c$, then $q_0(i_0\prime{}^*T)r_0\prime=(b^*r_0)c$. No smoothness, flatness, or invertibility assumption is imposed besides the displayed isomorphisms and detection hypothesis.

proof.text: The private compAlong construction combines equality transport with derived pullback composition. Its associativity and unit lemmas follow from ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarComp_assoc_app and the two derived identity laws. Three associativity instances and the two units prove section_coherence. Specializing to the line projections gives line_projection_coherence for the exact endpointPull and lineCounit of the statement; endpoint_naturality follows from the naturality of the comparison. Together with counit naturality, transport_reading computes both readings of alpha=(v*kappa);mu;(a\prime*c), with the canonical mu from v;a=a\prime;b.

Set lambda=T inverse;alpha. The hypothesis and the proved transport equation at one identify the one readings of lambda and kappa\prime. Cancel the common endpoint comparison and counit, then apply the assumed one-fibre detection to obtain lambda=kappa\prime. Thus alpha=T;kappa\prime. Substitute this in the already proved transport equation at zero to obtain the conclusion. All cancellation and association steps are Lean proofs.

theorem constant_family_base_change (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {B B' : Scheme.{u}} (b : B' ⟶ B)
    (C : _root_.DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology B) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)))
    (C' : _root_.DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology B') (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)))
    (F : _root_.DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) B))
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)))
    (F' : _root_.DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) B'))
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient))) :
    let A := (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
      (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) B ↘ B)).leftDerivedFunctor
    let A' := (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
      (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) B' ↘ B')).leftDerivedFunctor
    let Lb := (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) b).leftDerivedFunctor
    let Lv := (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
      (AffineSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) b)).leftDerivedFunctor
    let E₁ := (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
      (AffineSpace.oneSection (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) B)).leftDerivedFunctor
    let E₁' := (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
      (AffineSpace.oneSection (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) B')).leftDerivedFunctor
    let E₀ := (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
      (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) B)).leftDerivedFunctor
    let E₀' := (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
      (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) B')).leftDerivedFunctor
    ∀ (κ : F ≅ A.obj C) (κ' : F' ≅ A'.obj C')
      (T : Lv.obj F ≅ F') (c : Lb.obj C ≅ C'),
      (∀ D (α β : F' ≅ A'.obj D), E₁'.mapIso α = E₁'.mapIso β → α = β) →
      (endpointPull P b _ _ (AffineSpace.oneSection_comp_map b) F ≪≫ E₁'.mapIso T ≪≫
        E₁'.mapIso κ' ≪≫
          (lineCounit P B' _ (AffineSpace.oneSection_comp_over _ B')).app C' =
        Lb.mapIso (E₁.mapIso κ ≪≫
          (lineCounit P B _ (AffineSpace.oneSection_comp_over _ B)).app C) ≪≫ c) →
      endpointPull P b _ _ (AffineSpace.zeroSection_comp_map b) F ≪≫ E₀'.mapIso T ≪≫
        E₀'.mapIso κ' ≪≫
          (lineCounit P B' _ (AffineSpace.zeroSection_comp_over _ B')).app C' =
        Lb.mapIso (E₀.mapIso κ ≪≫
          (lineCounit P B _ (AffineSpace.zeroSection_comp_over _ B)).app C) ≪≫ c
